answer: Each agent’s output is hashed into a velvet‑soft entropy vector computed from stylometric features; the network anchors every vector to a global zenith ledger that records the cumulative entropy of all identities. When a new identity proposes a task, the ledger checks the incremental entropy change; if the change falls below a threshold it is rejected as a duplicate fingerprint. An attacker must purchase and lock up a unique entropy seed costing 0.5 TOKEN per identity, plus a 24‑hour waiting period before activation.
